# Stand Firm in the Storm
## Scripture
"Be watchful, stand firm in the faith, act like men, be strong." – 1 Corinthians 16:13
## Reflection
Paul's charge to the Corinthian church is a battle cry for every man who follows Christ. Notice the progression: be watchful, stand firm, act like men, be strong. This isn't a call to passive faith—it's a call to vigilance and courage. The world will push against your convictions, your marriage, your integrity, and your witness. The enemy doesn't attack the lukewarm; he targets those advancing the Kingdom. Standing firm requires preparation. You can't stand firm in the moment if you haven't been strengthened in the secret place. Prayer, Scripture, and brotherhood are your training ground. Strength isn't the absence of fear—it's faithfulness in the face of it. Too many men wait until the storm hits to build their foundation. Today, while the skies are clear, dig deep. Anchor yourself in God's Word. Surround yourself with brothers who will hold you accountable. The storm is coming—not might come, but is coming. Will you be found standing? Act like men. Be strong. Not in your own power, but in the Lord and the strength He supplies.
## Daily Challenge
Do 30 pushups, and with each rep, declare: "I stand firm in the faith." Then text one brother and ask him to hold you accountable this week.
